blind.description: No text, labels, or markings are visible on the model or scene. The model is a solid, continuous hard-surface structure consisting of a square stepped base with beveled corner footings, a vertical square column shaft reinforced with riveted dark metallic framing bands and a front-mounted sight glass / level indicator fixture, a flared capital section, and a flat square top platform with beveled outer edges and an inset square rim. Surfaces are completely continuous and solid without any shards, spikes, blobs, holes, or thin floating flakes. Nothing is hovering unattached, and no geometry is melted or fused. It stands independently on its own integrated stepped base directly on the floor with no added ground slab, disc, or external plinth, and its underside sits flat and flush on the floor. Materials consist of weathered dark charcoal/grey metal or stone with edge highlights, contrasted with warm amber/orange recessed panels; the top has a subtle reflective sheen. There are no plain black or unpainted areas, and no active flame or glow.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it appears as a solid dark grey square with chamfered corners and an inner concentric square groove/border, casting a diagonal rectangular shadow toward the upper-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 9 to 9.5 feet tall (roughly 1.6 times the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure, which reaches just below the flared capital); the central shaft is about 1.5 to 1.8 feet wide (comparable to the figure), while the stepped base and top platform are about 3 to 3.5 feet wide (roughly twice the figure width).
